title: Extract Panel Logic
short_description: Practice encapsulating reactive state and actions inside your first composable.
description: The panel interface currently works with local state and actions in App.vue.
Complete useDisclosure.ts and refactor the component to consume its API.
instructions: In useDisclosure.ts, implement open, close, and toggle by modifying isOpen.value.
Keep isOpen and all three actions in the returned API.
In App.vue, remove the local state and actions.
Call useDisclosure and destructure isOpen, open, close, and toggle.

hints.title: Reactive state
hints.body: The composable owns a `ref` named `isOpen`; its actions update `isOpen.value`.

hints.title: Toggle
hints.body: Implement `toggle` by assigning the opposite of the current `isOpen.value`.
